name: Suicide Bomber
body:
You are prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice to stop your foe.

Prerequisite: Bomb class feature.

Benefit: You must spend a full round action preparing for this attack during or just prior to combat. To execute the attack, you must first move into an opponent’s square, provoking an attack of opportunity. Then, as a standard action, you create and set off all your remaining bombs for the day simultaneously. You may not apply any discoveries to these bombs. You and your opponent are automatically hit by all of the bombs. Your opponent may make a single Reflex save for half damage from all of the bombs, you may not. Splash damage is treated as if only one bomb had gone off.
